duplicate_files.reason: EIP-6800: Beacon Chain Verkle Witness Validation - duplicate

properties.description: BLS aggregate signature must be verified over attested header using correct sync committee
properties.formal_statement: For all light client updates u: verify_bls_signature(sync_committee.aggregate_pubkey, attested_header_root, u.sync_aggregate.sync_committee_signature) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Prevents attacker from forging light client updates with invalid signatures. The aggregate signature is the primary cryptographic defense against malicious light client servers.
properties.verification_approach: Cryptographic verification using BLS12-381 pairing checks with sync committee public keys

properties.description: Slot ordering must satisfy finalized_slot <= attested_slot < signature_slot
properties.formal_statement: For all updates u: u.finalized_header.slot <= u.attested_header.slot < u.signature_slot
properties.rationale: Enforces temporal consistency in light client protocol. Prevents time-traveling attacks and ensures signatures are created after the data being signed.
properties.verification_approach: Arithmetic comparison of slot numbers

properties.description: Sync committee participation count must meet MIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PARTICIPANTS threshold
properties.formal_statement: For all updates u: sum(u.sync_aggregate.sync_committee_bits) >= MIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PARTICIPANTS
properties.rationale: Ensures sufficient validator participation before accepting update. Prevents attacks with low participation that may not represent honest majority.
properties.verification_approach: Count set bits in sync_committee_bits bitvector and compare to constant threshold

properties.description: Execution payload Merkle branch must verify against beacon body_root at EXECUTION_PAYLOAD_GINDEX=25
properties.formal_statement: For all Capella updates u: is_valid_merkle_branch(u.execution_payload_header, u.execution_branch, EXECUTION_PAYLOAD_GINDEX, u.attested_header.body_root) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Proves that execution payload header is correctly included in beacon block body. Critical for securing light client bridge to execution layer.
properties.verification_approach: Merkle branch verification using SHA256 hashing at generalized index 25

properties.description: For pre-Capella headers, execution fields must be default/empty values
properties.formal_statement: For all updates u where u.attested_header.slot < CAPELLA_FORK_SLOT: u.execution_payload_header = default(ExecutionPayloadHeader) AND u.execution_branch = []
properties.rationale: Ensures protocol backward compatibility and prevents malicious servers from providing fake execution data for pre-Capella blocks.
properties.verification_approach: Slot comparison and field equality checks against default values

properties.description: Sync committee signature verification must pass before finality proof is checked
properties.formal_statement: For all updates u: verify_sync_committee_signature(u) = TRUE IMPLIES check_finality_proof(u)
properties.rationale: Establishes correct verification order - signature must be valid before trusting any claimed finality information from untrusted source.
properties.verification_approach: Sequential validation logic with early return on signature failure

properties.description: Trusted block root must correspond to a canonical chain block; bootstrap Merkle proof must verify sync committee against header state root
properties.formal_statement: For bootstrap b: is_canonical(b.header.block_root) = TRUE AND is_valid_merkle_branch(b.current_sync_committee, b.current_sync_committee_branch, CURRENT_SYNC_COMMITTEE_GINDEX, b.header.state_root) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Bootstrap initialization is the trust root for entire light client protocol. Invalid bootstrap compromises all subsequent updates.
properties.verification_approach: External trust source validation + Merkle proof at generalized index for sync committee

properties.description: Execution payload parent_hash must match previous execution payload header
properties.formal_statement: For all blocks b at slot >= EIP6800_FORK_SLOT: b.body.execution_payload.parent_hash = hash_tree_root(previous_execution_payload_header)
properties.rationale: Maintains execution layer chain continuity across Verkle tree transition. Break in chain would allow state inconsistencies.
properties.verification_approach: Hash comparison between payload parent_hash field and hash_tree_root of previous header

properties.description: prev_randao must match current epoch RANDAO mix
properties.formal_statement: For all execution payloads p: p.prev_randao = get_randao_mix(state, get_current_epoch(state))
properties.rationale: Ensures execution layer receives correct randomness from consensus layer. Incorrect RANDAO could compromise validator selection and other random processes.
properties.verification_approach: Direct comparison of prev_randao field with state RANDAO mix at current epoch

properties.description: Blob KZG commitments count must not exceed MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK
properties.formal_statement: For all execution payloads p: len(p.blob_kzg_commitments) <= MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK
properties.rationale: Prevents DoS by limiting blob processing overhead. Enforces EIP-4844 blob count limits in post-Verkle context.
properties.verification_approach: Length comparison against MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK constant

properties.description: ExecutionWitness must conform to container constraints (MAX_STEMS, VERKLE_WIDTH, IPA_PROOF_DEPTH, MAX_COMMITMENTS_PER_STEM)
properties.formal_statement: For all execution witnesses w: len(w.state_diff) <= MAX_STEMS AND len(w.verkle_proof.commitments_by_path[i]) <= MAX_COMMITMENTS_PER_STEM AND len(w.verkle_proof.d) = VERKLE_WIDTH AND len(w.verkle_proof.ipa_proof.cl) = IPA_PROOF_DEPTH
properties.rationale: Enforces structural validity of Verkle witness data. Prevents oversized witnesses that could cause memory exhaustion or processing delays.
properties.verification_approach: Length and size validation against SSZ container max constraints

properties.description: IPA proof must be cryptographically valid (cl, cr vectors, final_evaluation)
properties.formal_statement: For all IPA proofs p: verify_ipa_proof(p.cl, p.cr, p.final_evaluation, commitment, evaluation_point) = TRUE
properties.rationale: IPA (Inner Product Argument) proof is the core cryptographic primitive for Verkle tree verification. Invalid proofs allow state forgery.
properties.verification_approach: Cryptographic verification using Pedersen commitments and Fiat-Shamir transform

properties.description: Block difficulty must be independently recalculated using fork-adjusted block number (max(0, block.number - 9,000,000) post-Muir Glacier)
properties.formal_statement: For all blocks b where b.number >= MUIR_GLACIER_FORK_BLOCK: fake_block_number = max(0, b.number - 9000000) AND expected_difficulty = difficulty_formula(fake_block_number)
properties.rationale: Muir Glacier adjusts ice age by delaying difficulty bomb. Incorrect calculation allows accepting blocks with wrong difficulty, potentially enabling chain manipulation.
properties.verification_approach: Arithmetic calculation with fork-specific block number adjustment

properties.description: Stated difficulty must exactly match computed expected difficulty
properties.formal_statement: For all blocks b: b.difficulty = expected_difficulty(b)
properties.rationale: Difficulty validation is core to PoW consensus security. Any mismatch indicates invalid block or consensus rule violation.
properties.verification_approach: Exact equality check between block header difficulty and computed value

properties.description: Contract runtime bytecode must not exceed 24576 bytes (24KB per EIP-170)
properties.formal_statement: For all contract creations c: len(c.runtime_code) <= 24576 OR creation_fails(c)
properties.rationale: EIP-170 limits contract size to prevent excessive state bloat and processing overhead. Exceeding limit must cause creation failure.
properties.verification_approach: Bytecode length comparison; gas consumption and failure on exceed

properties.description: For no-ether transactions, double-execution verification must confirm consideration consistency
properties.formal_statement: For all no-ether transactions t: consideration_first_run = execute(t.freeForAll) AND consideration_second_run = execute_again(t.freeForAll) AND consideration_first_run = consideration_second_run
properties.rationale: Double execution prevents non-deterministic consideration extraction. Inconsistency would allow transaction malleability and economic attacks.
properties.verification_approach: Two sequential executions with exact comparison of consideration results

properties.description: The safety_threshold must always equal floor(max_active_participants / 2)
properties.formal_statement: FORALL states s: s.safety_threshold = floor(s.max_active_participants / 2)
properties.rationale: Disambiguates safety threshold calculation method. Integer division behavior must be consistent across all implementations.
properties.verification_approach: Static analysis of threshold calculation; comparison with spec constant

properties.description: Force updates may only promote headers that passed full cryptographic validation
properties.formal_statement: FORALL force_updates f: f.promoted_header IN previously_validated_headers AND verify_sync_committee_signature(f.promoted_header) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Clarifies that force updates on timeout don't bypass signature verification - they only promote already-validated headers.
properties.verification_approach: State machine verification; check that promoted updates are subset of validated updates

properties.description: Merkle branch leading zeros must correspond to empty subtrees; branch must still produce correct root
properties.formal_statement: FORALL merkle_branches b: (b[i] = 0x00...00 IMPLIES subtree_at_sibling(i) = empty_tree) AND hash_merkle_path(leaf, b) = expected_root
properties.rationale: Clarifies interpretation of zero hashes in Merkle branches - they represent empty subtrees, not optimization shortcuts that bypass verification.
properties.verification_approach: Merkle proof verification with explicit empty subtree handling

properties.description: Initial trusted block root must correspond to canonical chain block
properties.formal_statement: FORALL bootstraps b: is_on_canonical_chain(b.trusted_block_root) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Assumes initial trust anchor is on the canonical chain. Light client security depends entirely on this bootstrap trust assumption.
properties.verification_approach: External trust source validation; out-of-band verification via trusted full node or social consensus

properties.description: Attacker controlling < 2/3 sync committee cannot forge valid finality updates
properties.formal_statement: FORALL adversaries A: (A.controlled_validators / SYNC_COMMITTEE_SIZE < 2/3) IMPLIES cannot_forge_finality_update(A)
properties.rationale: Assumes honest supermajority in sync committee. Security relies on at least 2/3 of sync committee being honest and following protocol.
properties.verification_approach: Cryptoeconomic analysis; validator selection randomness and slashing conditions

properties.description: Sync committee must be honestly elected; supermajority honest members required
properties.formal_statement: FORALL sync_committees c: election_process(c) = RANDOM_SHUFFLING AND honest_members(c) >= 2/3 * SYNC_COMMITTEE_SIZE
properties.rationale: Assumes sync committee is selected via secure random shuffling and maintains honest supermajority. Light client security depends on this.
properties.verification_approach: Cryptoeconomic analysis; RANDAO-based shuffling verification

properties.description: Deposit event data must be exactly 576 bytes with correct offsets
properties.formal_statement: FORALL deposit_logs l: len(l.data) = 576 AND pubkey_offset = 0 AND withdrawal_credentials_offset = 48 AND amount_offset = 80 AND signature_offset = 88 AND index_offset = 184
properties.rationale: Disambiguates deposit log ABI encoding format. Incorrect offsets would misparse deposit data leading to validator activation failures.
properties.verification_approach: ABI encoding validation; byte offset and length checks

properties.description: Request hashes concatenated in type order (deposit, withdrawal, consolidation)
properties.formal_statement: FORALL request_sets R: requests_hash = sha256(deposit_hash || withdrawal_hash || consolidation_hash) where types are ordered [0x00, 0x01, 0x02]
properties.rationale: Disambiguates request hashing order. Ensures deterministic commitment to requests regardless of processing order.
properties.verification_approach: Hash computation verification; type ordering validation

properties.description: Deposit contract at 0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa is trusted and immutable
properties.formal_statement: FORALL executions: deposit_contract_address = 0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa AND is_trusted(deposit_contract_address) = TRUE AND is_immutable(deposit_contract_address) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Assumes deposit contract is trusted and cannot be modified. Compromise of deposit contract would break validator activation security.
properties.verification_approach: Address constant verification; social consensus on contract trust

properties.description: Deposit request index must be monotonically increasing
properties.formal_statement: FORALL deposit_sequences D: D[i].index < D[i+1].index for all i
properties.rationale: Assumes deposit contract emits monotonically increasing indices. Non-monotonic indices would indicate contract compromise or reorg.
properties.verification_approach: Sequential index comparison across deposits

properties.description: MCOPY overlapping regions must produce same result as buffered copy
properties.formal_statement: FORALL mcopy_operations m: overlaps(m.src, m.dst, m.length) IMPLIES result(m) = result(buffered_copy(m.src, m.length, m.dst))
properties.rationale: Disambiguates overlapping memory copy behavior. MCOPY must behave like intermediate buffer copy, preventing implementation divergence.
properties.verification_approach: Memory state comparison; overlap detection and buffered copy simulation

properties.description: Quadratic memory cost formula provides sufficient DoS protection
properties.formal_statement: FORALL memory_expansions e: cost(e) = memory_size_word^2 / 512 + 3 * memory_size_word AND cost(e) > cost(e-1)
properties.rationale: Assumes quadratic memory cost prevents DoS via excessive memory allocation. Memory cost must grow super-linearly.
properties.verification_approach: Gas cost calculation verification; DoS scenario analysis

properties.description: All validator nodes must produce identical post-fork states at EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH
properties.formal_statement: FORALL validator_nodes n1, n2: state_at_epoch(n1, EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH) = state_at_epoch(n2, EIP6800_FORK_EPOCH)
properties.rationale: Assumes all validators execute identical fork transition logic. State divergence would cause consensus failure and chain split.
properties.verification_approach: State root comparison across validators; fork choice rule verification

properties.description: execution_witness_root equals hash_tree_root of ExecutionWitness container
properties.formal_statement: FORALL execution_payloads p: p.execution_witness_root = hash_tree_root(p.execution_witness)
properties.rationale: Disambiguates witness root calculation. Root must be deterministic SSZ hash tree root, not custom hash.
properties.verification_approach: SSZ hash_tree_root computation; root equality check

properties.description: Attacker cannot forge valid IPA proofs for incorrect state diffs
properties.formal_statement: FORALL adversaries A: verify_ipa_proof(A.forged_proof, incorrect_state_diff) = FALSE with overwhelming probability
properties.rationale: Assumes IPA proof system is cryptographically secure. Forgeable proofs would allow state corruption and theft.
properties.verification_approach: Cryptographic security proof; soundness analysis of IPA protocol

properties.description: All clients must implement identical difficulty calculation formula
properties.formal_statement: FORALL clients c1, c2, blocks b: difficulty(c1, b) = difficulty(c2, b)
properties.rationale: Assumes all clients implement identical difficulty formula. Divergence would cause chain splits and consensus failures.
properties.verification_approach: Cross-client testing; difficulty comparison on historical blocks

properties.description: Consideration received must be consistent between first and second execution runs
properties.formal_statement: FORALL no_ether_txs t: consideration_run1(t) = consideration_run2(t)
properties.rationale: Disambiguates consideration extraction behavior. Non-determinism would allow transaction malleability and double-spend attacks.
properties.verification_approach: Double execution with result comparison; determinism testing

properties.description: Free-for-all contract must correctly implement interface; tokens cannot be drained by unauthorized parties
properties.formal_statement: FORALL free_for_all_contracts f: implements_interface(f) = TRUE AND FORALL adversaries A: cannot_drain_without_favorable_evaluation(A, f) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Assumes free-for-all contracts are correctly implemented and secure. Vulnerable contracts would allow economic attacks.
properties.verification_approach: Contract interface verification; security audit and formal verification

properties.description: Opcode hex values remain unchanged regardless of mnemonic renaming
properties.formal_statement: FORALL opcodes o: hex_value(o) = constant AND mnemonic_change(o) IMPLIES hex_value(o) = hex_value_before_change(o)
properties.rationale: Assumes opcode renaming (REVERT→0xFD) only affects tooling/documentation, not consensus. Hex value changes would break contracts.
properties.verification_approach: Opcode table comparison; bytecode compatibility testing

properties.description: Empty accounts (balance=0, nonce=0, code=empty) must be deleted when touched
properties.formal_statement: FORALL accounts a: (a.balance = 0 AND a.nonce = 0 AND a.code = empty AND touched(a)) IMPLIES delete(a)
properties.rationale: Disambiguates account clearing behavior. Empty account deletion prevents state bloat from dust accounts created in early Ethereum.
properties.verification_approach: State transition verification; account deletion on touch with empty state

properties.description: After applying a valid update with supermajority, finalized_header must advance to the update's finalized_header slot
properties.formal_statement: FORALL updates u: (is_valid(u) AND has_supermajority(u)) IMPLIES post_state.finalized_header.slot = u.finalized_header.slot
properties.rationale: Ensures light client state progresses with valid finalized updates. Failure to advance indicates implementation bug or attack.
properties.verification_approach: State comparison before and after update; slot advancement check

properties.description: After force update on timeout, best_valid_update's attested header is promoted to finalized
properties.formal_statement: FORALL force_updates f: (timeout_occurred(f) AND best_valid_update_exists(f)) IMPLIES post_state.finalized_header = f.best_valid_update.attested_header
properties.rationale: Ensures light client can progress even without finality updates via force update mechanism after safety timeout.
properties.verification_approach: State transition verification on timeout; header promotion check

properties.description: After bootstrap verification, LightClientStore must contain the verified sync committee and header
properties.formal_statement: FORALL bootstraps b: verify_bootstrap(b) = TRUE IMPLIES (post_store.current_sync_committee = b.current_sync_committee AND post_store.finalized_header = b.header)
properties.rationale: Ensures bootstrap successfully initializes light client with verified sync committee and trusted header.
properties.verification_approach: Store state comparison after bootstrap; field equality checks

properties.description: After deposit extraction, all deposit logs from the deposit contract are collected in receipt order
properties.formal_statement: FORALL blocks b: extracted_deposits(b) = filter_logs(b.receipts, DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS, DEPOSIT_EVENT_SIGNATURE) in receipt_order
properties.rationale: Ensures all deposits are extracted deterministically in consistent order for beacon chain processing.
properties.verification_approach: Deposit list verification; order and completeness checks

properties.description: After request hashing, final hash deterministically commits to all requests
properties.formal_statement: FORALL request_sets R: requests_hash(R) = sha256(concat_by_type(R)) AND identical_requests(R1, R2) IMPLIES requests_hash(R1) = requests_hash(R2)
properties.rationale: Ensures request commitment is deterministic and binding. Different orderings of same requests produce same hash.
properties.verification_approach: Hash determinism testing; collision resistance verification

properties.description: After MCOPY execution, memory[dst:dst+length] equals the pre-copy value of memory[src:src+length]
properties.formal_statement: FORALL mcopy_ops m: post_memory[m.dst : m.dst + m.length] = pre_memory[m.src : m.src + m.length]
properties.rationale: Ensures MCOPY correctly copies memory region. Incorrect copy would break contract execution semantics.
properties.verification_approach: Memory state comparison; byte-by-byte equality check

properties.description: After MCOPY, gas is reduced by exactly 3 + 3*ceil(length/32) + memory_expansion_cost
properties.formal_statement: FORALL mcopy_ops m: gas_consumed(m) = 3 + 3 * ceil(m.length / 32) + memory_expansion_cost(m.dst, m.length)
properties.rationale: Ensures correct gas accounting for MCOPY. Incorrect gas could enable DoS or underpriced operations.
properties.verification_approach: Gas calculation verification; comparison with spec formula

properties.description: After fork upgrade, beacon state fork version is EIP6800_FORK_VERSION and all pre-fork fields preserved
properties.formal_statement: FORALL fork_upgrades f: post_state.fork.current_version = EIP6800_FORK_VERSION AND preserved_fields(pre_state, post_state) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Ensures fork upgrade correctly updates version while preserving existing state. State corruption would cause consensus failure.
properties.verification_approach: State comparison before and after fork; version field check

properties.description: After Verkle proof verification, state diff can be trusted for state transition application
properties.formal_statement: FORALL verkle_proofs p: verify_verkle_proof(p) = TRUE IMPLIES can_apply_state_diff(p.state_diff) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Ensures verified Verkle proofs provide trusted state diff for application. Invalid diffs would corrupt state.
properties.verification_approach: Proof verification followed by state diff application; integrity checks

properties.description: After touching an empty account, it must be deleted from the state trie
properties.formal_statement: FORALL account_touches t: (is_empty(t.account) AND touched(t.account)) IMPLIES NOT exists_in_state(t.account, post_state)
properties.rationale: Ensures empty accounts are cleaned up after touch. Prevents state bloat from dust accounts.
properties.verification_approach: State trie inspection; account existence check after touch

properties.description: After contract creation exceeding 24KB, the creation must fail and consume all gas
properties.formal_statement: FORALL contract_creations c: len(c.runtime_code) > 24576 IMPLIES (creation_failed(c) AND gas_remaining(c) = 0)
properties.rationale: Ensures oversized contract creation fails deterministically with all gas consumed. Prevents state bloat.
properties.verification_approach: Creation result verification; gas consumption check on failure

properties.description: After Muir Glacier activation, difficulty uses fake_block_number = max(0, block.number - 9,000,000)
properties.formal_statement: FORALL blocks b WHERE b.number >= MUIR_GLACIER_FORK_BLOCK: difficulty_calc_uses(fake_block_number(b)) AND fake_block_number(b) = max(0, b.number - 9000000)
properties.rationale: Ensures difficulty calculation uses adjusted block number post-Muir Glacier. Delays ice age difficulty bomb.
properties.verification_approach: Difficulty calculation verification; fake block number computation check

properties.description: After favorable evaluation, transaction batch and consideration extraction are committed atomically
properties.formal_statement: FORALL no_ether_txs t: favorable_evaluation(t) = TRUE IMPLIES (committed(t.batch) AND extracted(t.consideration)) atomically
properties.rationale: Ensures favorable transactions commit both batch and consideration extraction together. Partial commit would break economic model.
properties.verification_approach: Transaction atomicity verification; state commitment check

properties.description: After unfavorable evaluation, entire context is rolled back with no state changes
properties.formal_statement: FORALL no_ether_txs t: favorable_evaluation(t) = FALSE IMPLIES post_state = pre_state
properties.rationale: Ensures unfavorable transactions are completely reverted. Partial state changes would break transaction semantics.
properties.verification_approach: State comparison before and after unfavorable transaction; complete rollback verification

properties.description: Finalized header slot must never decrease in the LightClientStore
properties.formal_statement: FORALL state_transitions s: post_state.finalized_header.slot >= pre_state.finalized_header.slot
properties.rationale: Fundamental monotonicity invariant for light client. Slot decrease would indicate time-travel attack or protocol violation.
properties.verification_approach: State invariant checking; slot comparison across all state transitions

properties.description: MCOPY with length=0 must be a no-op costing only base gas (3)
properties.formal_statement: FORALL mcopy_ops m WHERE m.length = 0: memory_unchanged(m) AND gas_cost(m) = 3
properties.rationale: Ensures zero-length MCOPY is handled efficiently without memory operations. Edge case that must be specified.
properties.verification_approach: Edge case testing; gas and memory state verification for zero-length

properties.description: Empty ExecutionWitness initialization ([], []) must not cause validation edge cases for first post-fork block
properties.formal_statement: FORALL first_post_fork_blocks b: b.execution_witness = ExecutionWitness([], []) IMPLIES valid_witness(b) = TRUE
properties.rationale: Ensures empty witness for first block is valid. Edge case at fork boundary must be handled correctly.
properties.verification_approach: Fork boundary testing; empty witness validation

properties.description: Request type bytes (0x00=deposit, 0x01=withdrawal, 0x02=consolidation) are exhaustive for Prague fork
properties.formal_statement: FORALL requests r IN prague_blocks: r.type IN {0x00, 0x01, 0x02} AND type_handling_complete({0x00, 0x01, 0x02})
properties.rationale: Ensures all request types defined in Prague are handled. Missing type handlers would cause processing failures.
properties.verification_approach: Type enumeration verification; handler coverage testing
